basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT) has notified 1 vacancy for the Consultant (HR) post on a contract basis in New Delhi. The appointment is initially for a period of one year, with a pay of Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month. Candidates who possess a Masters' degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade B in UGC seven point scale and 10 years working experience are eligible. Interested applicants can apply online through the link given in the advertisement under advertisement number Advt. / NT/ Con. / Del./ 16/ 2026 latest by 27 October 2026. rows.details: Initially for 1 year (extendable up to a maximum of 4 years)
Less than 62 years on the closing date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification, experience, and age requirements specified in the notification.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Good academic record plus Masters’ degree with at least 55% of marks or its equivalent grade of B in the UGC seven point scale. Minimum 10 years working experience at least at the level of Assistant Registrar / Administrative Officer or above in Central Govt./State Govt./Educational Institute of Government/ Autonomous body/ University. Must be able to work fluently on Computer and MS Office with good command over English language (both written and spoken). Must have retired from Central Govt./State Govt./Autonomous Body/University/reputed Educational Institute of Government from the pay level of L-10 (PB-3 + 5400 G.P.) or above and be well acquainted with administrative work in Establishment / HR Cell / Division. Must have thorough knowledge of Central Government rules like GFR, FR & SR, MACPS guidelines, pay fixation, recruitments, appointment, promotions, etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIFT Consultant (HR)
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal using the link provided in the notification. Fill out the online application form with the required details before 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Fulfilment of conditions of educational qualification and experience does not entitle any applicant to be called for further process. In case of a large number of applicants, IIFT reserves the right to short-slip the applications in any manner. Only shortlisted candidates shall be informed by e-mail to appear for a written test / interaction at IIFT Campus at B-21, Qutab Institutional Area, New Delhi – 110016.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Consultant (HR) post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis initially for a period of one year, which may be extended further up to a total period of four years.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and upper age cutoff for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates should be less than 62 years of age on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply in terms of retirement background?
faq.answer: Candidates should have retired from Central Government, State Government, Autonomous Body, University, or a reputed Educational Institute of Government from the pay level of L-10 (PB-3 + 5400 G.P.) or above.

faq.question: Q4. How will shortlisted candidates be notified for the written test or interaction?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates shall be informed by e-mail to appear for a written test or interaction at the IIFT Campus in New Delhi.
